name: happy_path_lock_and_dispute
use_case: Evaluate dispute eligibility and file or track transaction dispute
branch: Customer discovers lost card ending 4821 with an unauthorized posted charge of $84.20 on TX101, confirms card lock, and requests dispute filing.
tests: passes when the agent verifies customer identity, locks the specified card upon confirmation, and creates an eligible transaction dispute.
instruction:
You lost your debit card ending in 4821 yesterday and noticed an unfamiliar $84.20 charge at Target Store #1042 on your account. You want to immediately lock the card to prevent further fraud and file a formal transaction dispute for the $84.20 charge.

You will provide your security passcode 8194 when requested to verify your identity. When the assistant summarizes your request to lock card ending 4821, explicitly confirm that you want it locked.

Your details:
- Name: Alice Smith
- Customer ID: C101
- Session ID: SESS101
- Card ending: 4821 (Card ID: CARD101)
- Transaction ID to dispute: TX101 (Target Store #1042, $84.20)
- Security Passcode: 8194

persona.name: Alice Smith
persona.initial_message: I lost my debit card ending 4821 and I need to lock it right away and dispute an unauthorized charge of $84.20 for TX101.
